title: Japan protests China's travel advisory over Taiwan remarks
description: BEIJING, Nov 15: Japan raised objections Saturday after China advised its citizens to avoid visiting Japan, as a feud over the new Japanese leader’s remarks on Taiwan showed no signs of dying down. The government in Tokyo lodged a protest and its top spokesperson, Chief Cabinet Secretary Minoru Kihara, urged China to take “appropriate measures,” Japan’s Kyodo News Service reported. title: Japan Urges China to Act After Travel Warning: Kyodo
description: Japan on Saturday urged China to take “appropriate measures” after Beijing warned its citizens against visiting Japan, Kyodo reported, amid an ongoing dispute over Taiwan.

title: China Furious Over Japan PM’s Taiwan Policy, Summons Ambassador, Issues Travel Advisory
description: The relations between China and Japan became extremely tense after the comments made by the Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi regarding Taiwan, which led Beijing to call Japan's ambassador and issue a travel warning. In turn, Japan reacted by calling in the Chinese ambassador due to a menacing post at the consulate, which brought the diplomatic impasse to its peak in years.
